label: Philips North America
headline: Took the traceability platform from a three-business pilot to a fourth business

year_layers.narrative: Guided the team behind the AI-assisted traceability platform from its first milestone in January through a pilot in three businesses to adoption by a fourth, with two more planned for 2026 and two businesses scoring it 10 out of 10. Won funding for an AI defect-triage project with Ultrasound and coordinated it through its first milestone, taught 27 AI sessions to 1,000+ people and co-wrote the proposal for a shared knowledge layer for AI agents. Was named solution architect for the contextual intelligence layer in the 2027 resource model.
numbers: 3 businesses in the pilot, 4 using it after

quote.text: Datta's communication and collaboration style is very positive and always looking for opportunities. It is simply lovely to collaborate with him. His vision is inspiring.

year_layers.narrative: Owned a goal to lead the move from AI experiments to value, rated Exceeds. Led a 33-session Philips University program for 492 learners, built an AI agent that checks requirements against IEC 62304 and brought it onto the company AI platform, and coached trainers so teams could carry AI adoption themselves. One team's AI confidence rose from 4.5 to 7.6 in three days.

quote.text: He did an amazing job in conducting several PU led trainings, which were very positively rated and received by the participants, also resulting in higher funding from PU.

year_layers.narrative: As Software Excellence Competency Lead managing nine competency experts, turned an indifferent business relationship with Ultrasound into trust and led the proof of concept that first ran its test suites on virtual machines. Led the team that organized Developer Days India for 250+ engineers, held 104 connects with 389 colleagues and brought static analysis and code-health tooling into product pipelines.
numbers: ~3 min test run on a VM

quote.text: Many thanks to each of the teammates who helped think through the 'art of possibility'.

year_layers.narrative: I supervised software competency experts in North America, building on earlier supervisory experience in Philips India. I led the State of Software Craftsmanship report on 138 projects, ran the Back2Basics workshop for about 50 engineers and organized the US developer portal hackathon with the Software Excellence team. All three goals were rated Exceeds Expectations, and feedback from the businesses was 100% positive.

quote.text: Feedback from businesses is 100% positive and thanks you for your skill and calm, clear communication.

year_layers.narrative: Owned the craftsmanship assessment program, which raised the average assessment score from 67 to 78. Led InnerSource adoption in business units, where shared GitHub workflows cut the setup of a required security scanner from months to minutes. Helped a SaaS team take its DevOps pipeline to a working Alpha with design history and test automation built in, and led the graduate program's software track.
numbers: Months to minutes for security-scanner setup

quote.text: This wasn't just a "task"; this was a vision, an implementation of the vision, and a successful selling of the vision to teams that needed it to be sold to them for their own success.

year_layers.narrative: Promoted to Software Excellence Competency Lead in November and transferred from Bengaluru to Philips North America to lead software excellence programs for North American and Latin American businesses. Three goals were rated Exceeds Expectations, including changing how teams work through those programs, and my manager called me a steadying force through the team's shift to continuous value delivery.

quote.text: Datta has been a pivotal member of the SW CoE team for years and has been deservedly rewarded with a promotion this year.

scope: Set the software excellence strategy and KPIs for US and Latin American businesses within the global strategy, agreed them with business leaders and senior executives, and reported progress to senior leaders each quarter and cost savings to finance and business leaders.

Owned assessment-led programs on software quality, reliability, security and regulatory compliance, from document reviews, stakeholder interviews and data analysis to a plan built with cross-functional leaders, results reported to business heads and a follow-up six to twelve months later.

Led InnerSource adoption with US and Latin American businesses, brought engineering teams into the Software Craftsmanship program through change champions, and directed software due diligence on acquired businesses against ISO 13485, ISO 14971 and IEC 62304.

Led cross-functional, geographically diverse teams across the Software Center of Excellence throughout my Philips career in India and North America, with full accountability for digital transformation outcomes: delegating execution, recommending hires, and owning performance reviews and career-progression decisions across a team spanning 6 nationalities and 12 locations.

Raised the hiring bar for US and Latin American teams by mentoring leaders and architects on interviewing and interviewing for senior roles, and built software competency frameworks delivered through Philips University.

As Software Competency Lead, directed AI-enabled transformations for regulated engineering, including an AI-assisted traceability platform piloted in three businesses and adopted by a fourth and a requirements agent that checks requirements against IEC 62304.
Our Software Competency team became part of Innovation Engineering during a reorganization; my title, role and responsibilities remained unchanged.

Delivered skills across the engineering organization with a 33-session Philips University program for 492 learners and 27 AI sessions for more than 1,000 people in 2026, and in Sep 2026 was named solution architect for the contextual intelligence layer.

company.took: North America is where I learned to lead AI-enabled transformation in regulated software. Trust comes before tooling: listen to what a business needs, show a working result, then scale it, which is how the traceability platform went from a pilot in three businesses to a fourth that chose to adopt it. In regulated work AI earns its place only when a person can see, check and own every decision it touches, so I surface the evidence for a person to judge before automating the judgment. Leading a global team taught me that my job is to make that standard easy for others to hold, not to hold it alone.
